I couldn't set up the Monday digest, and I've told Bettina in a reply on her message in #coastal-team.

The scheduler needs credentials that I don't have. Every request I made to it was rejected, so no recurring job exists and I haven't posted a digest.

I told her what I'd create once an admin fixes it:
- **Schedule:** Mondays at 08:00 Central, starting 19 Oct.
- **Content:** a "Coastal week ahead" post in #coastal-team. It would cover the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items.
- **Exclusions:** finance figures and anything from DMs.
- **Audience:** both channels have the same members, so nobody new would see anything.

Until the scheduler works, I can post the digest by hand if she asks me on a Monday.
